f.t: Greg Katz and Amanda Tannen wrote the band's breakout single ‘Dry Heat/Nice Town’ after attending the 2017 Women's March.
f.q: Katz and Tannen wrote what would become the group's breakout single, "Dry Heat/Nice Town" (2018), after attending the 2017 Women's March.

f.t: At a 2019 show at The Satellite in Los Angeles, a small group sang along to every word of one song, startling Greg Katz so much he forgot several of his own lines.
f.q: in 2019 while playing a set at The Satellite in Los Angeles, Katz was startled when a small group of attendees sang along to every word in one of the band's tracks, temporarily causing him to forget several lines of his own lyrics.

f.t: Greg Katz lost his record-label job in 2011 and started his own label, New Professor Music, which has released all of the band's albums.
f.q: Katz, who played bass in the band LA Font, lost his job in 2011 and thereafter began his own label, New Professor Music.
